name: bridge
description: Hemingway bridge for Claude Code sessions. End a session the way Hemingway ended a writing day: stop while it is going well, knowing exactly what comes next, and write that down. /bridge writes a forward-looking note (next sentence, where I stopped, status, details that will be forgotten, intention, open loops); a SessionStart hook shows open bridges to the next session, and "resume" reads the note, checks it against reality, marks it crossed and does the next sentence instead of re-exploring. Plain Markdown files, no Obsidian needed (but drops into a vault if you have one). bash only, sends nothing.
